title: Artist-in-Residence Program
cost_text: $1100 / mo. plus $200 refundable security deposit and $100 non-refundable cleaning fee
how_to_join: Email hkreitchet@gmail.com with arrival and departure dates
summary: Emerging and established artists can reside for one month to three years, with dedicated studio space, private bedroom, and participation in group wood firings and community tasks.
evidence_sentence: The Artist-in-Residence program provides time and facilities for artists to participate in communal wood firings and develop their work.
source_quote:
Duration: One month to three years
Cost: $1100 / mo.
